title: Structuring ring consolidating to one account
summary: Eight accounts each made two cash deposits between $9,000 and $9,900 within three days, then moved the funds to a single collector account. Deposits stayed just below the $10,000 reporting threshold.

outcome: Closed: false positive, legitimate cash business
title: Busy retail account with many small payers
summary: Established business account opened years ago receiving many small card payments from hundreds of different payers. Balance stays in the account and a regular monthly payroll leaves. No structuring, no offshore activity.

outcome: SAR filed; account frozen; offshore account referred to law enforcement
title: Fan-in mule account with offshore wire
summary: Five to six recently opened accounts, each funded by cash deposits just under $10,000, sent just-under-$10,000 transfers to one newly opened account over three days. Within 48 hours that account wired about 100 percent of the funds in a single round-amount wire to an offshore account in the Cayman Islands with no onward activity.

title: Large invoice passed between established business accounts
summary: A large payment arrived at one established business account and was passed on within two days to a supplier. Invoices and a purchase order were on file. Both accounts had years of history.

title: Round-number transfers to many small accounts
summary: One account repeatedly sent round-number transfers of $4,000 to $5,000 to many unrelated small accounts shortly after receiving a single large inbound transfer.

title: Payroll account with many small outbound payments
summary: Business account sending many small outbound transfers on the same day each month to long-standing recipients, funded by a regular inbound transfer. Consistent history over two years.

title: New-account burst with wire to Panama
summary: Account opened three weeks earlier received about $80,000 from unrelated individuals within four days and wired nearly all of it to an account in Panama.

title: Student account receiving family remittances
summary: Personal account receiving round-amount transfers from the same two senders each month, spent on rent and tuition. No pass-through, no new-account senders.

title: Circular transfers between three accounts
summary: Three accounts opened the same week passed the same funds in a circle several times before one account wired the balance abroad. No business purpose found.
